Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-001
Rule.Description: Detects mobile app data storage issues including unencrypted SQLite databases and shared preferences

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-002
Rule.Description: Detects mobile apps communicating over HTTP, using weak TLS, or accepting self-signed certificates

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-003
Rule.Description: Detects hardcoded credentials, API keys, or tokens in mobile app binaries or configuration files

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-004
Rule.Description: Detects mobile app authorization bypass through rooted or jailbroken devices or debug modes

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-005
Rule.Description: Detects Android intent spoofing or iOS deep link abuse for unauthorized actions

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-006
Rule.Description: Detects SSL/TLS certificate pinning bypass attempts on mobile applications

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-007
Rule.Description: Detects sensitive data such as tokens, passwords, or PII logged by mobile applications in cleartext

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-008
Rule.Description: Detects mobile apps exposing sensitive data through the system clipboard

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-009
Rule.Description: Detects attempts to bypass biometric authentication on mobile devices

Rule.name: FSIEM-MOB-010
Rule.Description: Detects screen capture or recording while sensitive content is displayed on mobile devices
